headline: Estée Lauder Companies (EL) Glimmer Launch Puts Its Recovery Valuation Story In Focus
summary: Estée Lauder Companies (EL) has put its fragrance business in the spotlight with Glimmer, a new prestige scent fronted by Hailee Steinfeld and positioned around themes of optimism, connection, and everyday “glimmers.” See our latest analysis for Estée Lauder Companies. Against this backdrop, recent product and leadership moves at Estée Lauder Companies, including the Glimmer launch and changes in its communications and board line-up, come after a period where short-term momentum has picked up...
